visual.name: codexKpiWall
visual.description: Multi-card KPI grid with auto-fit responsive layout, per-card accent driver, change pills, and subtle data-update shine animation.

en-US.Visual_Landing_Message: Add a Card label and a Headline value to begin.

dataRoles.name: cardLabel

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: The headline number on each card

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional. Drives the band colour, delta pill, and target strip

dataRoles.name: sortOrder
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric sort key - cards follow it ascending

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Extra measures for the hover tooltip
